title: EchoJEPA: A Latent Predictive Foundation Model for Echocardiography
abstract: Latent predictive pretraining on a large echocardiography corpus is evaluated for cardiac measurements, view classification, sample efficiency, perturbation robustness, and pediatric transfer. The study does not expose an action variable or evaluate free-running future-state rollout, so eligibility depends on whether latent temporal prediction alone satisfies the review's dynamics boundary.
authors: Alif Munim; Adibvafa Fallahpour; Teodora Szasz; Ahmadreza Attarpour; River Jiang; Brana Sooriyakanthan; Maala Sooriyakanthan; Heather M. Whitney; Jeremy Slivnick; Barry B. Rubin

title: Xray2Xray: World Model from Chest X-rays with Volumetric Context
abstract: The model learns latent transition dynamics between chest-radiograph projection angles, evaluates synthesis and volumetric reconstruction, and transfers the representation to diagnosis and cardiovascular-risk prediction. Projection angle functions as a non-therapeutic acquisition action.
authors: Zefan Yang; X. Michael Song; Xuanang Xu; Yongyi Shi; Ge Wang; Mannudeep K. Kalra; Pingkun Yan

title: Treatment-aware Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Longitudinal MRI Generation and Diffuse Glioma Growth Prediction
abstract: A treatment- and time-conditioned diffusion model predicts future multiparametric MRI and tumor masks from real postoperative longitudinal glioma data. Evaluation covers future image generation, serial tumor segmentation, growth prediction, and uncertainty under recorded treatment plans.
authors: Qinghui Liu; Elies Fuster-García; Ivar Thokle Hovden; Bradley J. MacIntosh; Edvard Grødem; Petter Brandal; Carles Lopez-Mateu; Donatas Sederevičius; Karoline Skogen; Till Schellhorn

title: Cosmos-H-Surgical: Learning Surgical Robot Policies from Videos via World Modeling
abstract: A surgical video world model generates synthetic procedures, an inverse-dynamics model infers pseudo-kinematics, and the resulting paired video-action data train a vision-language-action policy. The policy is evaluated on a real surgical robot and compared with training on real demonstrations alone.
authors: Yufan He; Pengfei Guo; Mengya Xu; Zhaoshuo Li; Andriy Myronenko; Dillan Imans; Bingjie Liu; Dongren Yang; Mingxue Gu; Yongnan Ji

title: Surgical Vision World Model
abstract: The study learns latent actions from unlabeled surgical video and uses them to generate action-controllable surgical observations. Experiments on SurgToolLoc-2022 assess the learned action space and generated-video behavior for interactive surgical simulation.
authors: Saurabh Koju; Saurav Bastola; Prashant Shrestha; Sanskar Amgain; Yash Raj Shrestha; Rudra P. K. Poudel; Binod Bhattarai

title: Surgical Procedural Planning as 3D World Modelling: Towards Automated Pulmonary Resection
abstract: A 3D medical world model combines CT-and-text perception, an action-conditioned diffusion simulator of anatomical changes, and a decision engine that searches feasible pulmonary-resection sequences. Evaluation on clinical cases reports step-level planning performance and surgeon ratings of feasibility and lung preservation.
authors: Zhen Zhang; Zhaorong Dong; Xiao Yang; Liqin Huang; Qiang Wu; Taidui Zeng; Hanyu Zheng; Mingjing Yang; Shaohua Zheng; Wangbin Ding; Lin Pan
